style.shell: Setting: a newly completed engineering office on an upper floor of a modern building in Gyeonggi-do, South Korea, used by the field service engineers of a semiconductor equipment company. Building shell: white-painted exposed concrete ceiling with tidy linear LED lighting and charcoal felt acoustic baffles, light-grey polished concrete floor with warm-grey carpet tiles in work areas, floor-to-ceiling windows with slim black mullions looking out on distant green hills and low-rise city blocks. Material palette: pale white oak, matte white laminate, warm-grey and sage-green felt, black powder-coated steel, one accent of deep navy blue.
style.realism: All furniture is real, manufacturable contract office furniture with correct proportions, realistic joints and neat visible cable management. Lighting: soft natural daylight from the windows on a bright overcast afternoon, mixed with warm-neutral 4000K ceiling light, gentle realistic shadows. Look: true-to-life colour, subtle real-world texture and slight wear, magazine-quality but believable, as if photographed the week the office opened. The space is completely empty of people; only a few quiet signs of use such as a closed laptop or a coffee mug.

camera.wide: Camera: full-frame camera, 24mm tilt-shift lens, eye level at 1.5 m, two-point perspective with perfectly vertical lines, f/8, deep focus.
camera.high: Camera: full-frame camera, 24mm tilt-shift lens, raised vantage point at about 3 m looking diagonally down across the space, vertical lines kept straight, f/8, deep focus.
camera.medium: Camera: full-frame camera, 35mm lens, eye level at 1.3 m, three-quarter view, f/5.6, background softly in focus.
camera.detail: Camera: full-frame camera, 50mm lens, seated eye level at 1.1 m, three-quarter view of the desk, f/4, gentle background blur.

style.negative: Negative prompt: people, faces, hands, logos, brand names, readable text, signage, watermarks, distorted or melting furniture, extra chair legs, floating objects, warped straight lines, fisheye distortion, lens flare, oversaturated colours, plastic CGI render look, illustration or cartoon style, clutter.
